analysis.message: 69-year-old male, T2, 108kg. Messy irregular log. Dominant post-lunch hypoglycemia pattern. Likely sulfonylurea-induced or exaggerated endogenous insulin response. Consider medication dose reduction or switch to lower hypoglycemia risk agent.
